intro: Sigrun Ironhew, waiting in the Badlands for word from Ironforge, knows a technique for imbuing weapons with fire. It needs blood from the still-beating heart of a rare black drake whelp, and the whelps of Lethlor Ravine are where to find one.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, I learned his special technique for imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments. Last I heard of him, he was working at a smithy with a hunting party up in Lordaeron.

I can't tell you too many of the details about the process, but I can tell you it requires blood from a rare, still-beating black drake whelp's heart. I don't have much to do waiting for word from Ironforge. If you bring me a heart from the whelps in Lethlor Ravine, I'll show you my skill!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, this will do excellently. This will enable your weapons to strike with searing heat!
